proof_0049.moves: In a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected space the clopen sets form a topological basis; since U is open and contains x, U is a neighbourhood of x, so the basis characterisation of neighbourhoods hands back a clopen V with x in V and V inside U. Two named facts plus one Iff elimination.

proof_0050.moves: Products over the coercion of a set to a subtype equal products over its Finset image, by invoking the general prod_subtype lemma with the membership equivalence x in s.toFinset iff x in s, then flipping the equality direction.

proof_0051.moves: Pure transfer: the statement about Ord.compare on the minimum key after modify is exactly the already-proved compare-flavoured lemma, applied verbatim. No mathematical step of its own.

proof_0052.moves: Applies the corresponding statement about the inverse of the monoidal comparison isomorphism on free generators; the delta of the free functor is by construction that inverse, so the proof is a single application.

proof_0053.moves: Set.piecewise s f g is definitionally the if-then-else on membership in s, so the whole proof is applying the continuity criterion for if-then-else, using the hypothesis that f and g agree on the frontier of s. The defeq unfolding of piecewise is content no citation names.

proof_0054.moves: Take n in the support of p; then n is at most the natural degree of p, which is strictly below m, so n is in range m. The proof is a lambda over the subset relation, a bound on support elements, and one transitivity of at-most with strictly-less.

proof_0055.moves: ofList is by definition insertMany applied to the empty map, so containment in the resulting tree map reduces to the corresponding statement about insertMany from an empty implementation map; the proof is that one transfer.

proof_0056.moves: ContinuousWithinAt is by definition a Tendsto statement along the within-neighbourhood filter, so the scalar-multiple-by-a-natural version follows by applying the corresponding Tendsto lemma to the hypothesis. Continuity of addition is what makes nsmul continuous.

proof_0057.moves: An auto-generated simp lemma for the inverse of the linear equivalence obtained by post-composing locally constant functions with e; since the underlying map of the symm direction is literally mapping by e.symm, the proof is reflexivity. Definitional unfolding is the whole content.

proof_0058.moves: The extensional tree map is a quotient wrapper around the dependent tree map, so getElem in terms of the option-valued lookup is inherited verbatim from the constant-value dependent version. Single transfer step.

proof_0059.moves: Exhibit the explicit basis 1, i, j, k indexed by Fin 4 and feed it to the criterion that a module with a basis indexed by a finite type is module-finite. Everything else is instance plumbing.

proof_0060.moves: The strict and non-strict position predicates on a string slice unfold to the same underlying raw-position comparison against the slice's end, so the proof is reflexivity. Pure definitional unfolding; the counterpart posGE is not even among the candidates.

proof_0061.moves: The coercion from the reals into an RCLike field is the algebra map, so negation is preserved by the general fact that ring-hom-style algebra maps commute with negation. One citation; the rest is the instance tower assembling the algebra structure.

proof_0062.moves: On the model space itself the chart is the identity partial equivalence and the model with corners is the identity, so the extended chart is refl composed with refl; simp unfolds the definitions and the composition-with-refl lemma collapses it. Almost everything else here is simp-normalisation residue.

proof_0063.moves: An extensionality lemma for partial isomorphisms of schemes: given equalities of source and target, the isomorphism components match after transporting along isoOfEq, and the ext_iff characterisation is applied with those witnesses supplied. The real content is supplying the witness and rewriting along ext_iff.

proof_0064.moves: Build the MeasurePreserving structure from its two fields: the isometry equivalence is continuous hence measurable (using the Borel structure), and the already-proved fact that an isometry equivalence pushes Hausdorff measure to Hausdorff measure gives the map condition.

proof_0065.moves: Function-level version of the pointwise statement: apply funext and then quote the pointwise theorem that the derivative of a constant plus f equals the derivative of f. Only two steps, one of which is pure eta/extensionality.

proof_0066.moves: Conditional independence of sets is defined as kernel independence with respect to the conditional expectation kernel, so the union criterion is literally the kernel-level union criterion. Single unfolding-plus-transfer.

proof_0067.moves: Start from the identity cosh squared equals sinh squared plus one and commute the two summands to get one plus sinh squared. One real identity chained with commutativity of addition.

proof_0068.moves: The function 1 in a Pi type is the constant function with value 1, so pointwise extensionality plus the derivative-of-a-constant lemma gives the zero function. Two steps; the rest is the normed-space instance tower.

proof_0069.moves: For real-valued integrands the absolute value is the norm, so the statement that the absolute value of an interval integral equals that over the unordered interval is the norm version verbatim. The defeq of abs and norm on the reals is unnamed content.

proof_0070.moves: To show a scalar multiple of a left-invariant measure is left-invariant, construct the structure and for each g rewrite the pushforward of a scaled measure as the scaled pushforward, then apply left-invariance of the original measure to get the measure back.

proof_0071.moves: The monoid hom sending a dilation to its ratio has underlying function literally Dilation.ratio, so the application lemma is reflexivity. Pure unfolding of a bundled structure; the target Dilation.ratio itself is not in the candidate list.

proof_0072.moves: From a simply connected subset get the SimplyConnectedSpace instance on the subtype, which supplies a PathConnectedSpace instance by typeclass search, then transfer back across the equivalence between a set being path connected and its subtype being a path connected space.
